summary: Four findings, no BLOCKERs at HEAD 28f7942. PRF-001 LOW (validationVerdict.js:663 regex never matches producer's actual detail strings — absent-record cases get FAIL/NON_COMPLIANT instead of INCOMPLETE/ENGINEERING_REVIEW). PRF-002 LOW (engine/haat/validate.js:144 flat-fallback suppression incorrectly gated on operatorHaat>0). PRF-003 INFO (verifies commit 6a25ce7's tier-3 fallback cap at lines 510-521 correctly downgrades VERIFIED→PARTIAL). PRF-004 WARNING (golden suites did not re-execute this cycle — harness-gated). Deploy recommendation: WARN until tests green-light at head 28f7942.

findings.title: validationVerdict.js:663 regex /no [a-z_]+ record attached/i never matches the producer's actual detail strings; absent-record cases mis-classified
findings.recommended_fix: Replace the regex with /\bINCOMPLETE pending re-compute\b/i.test(detail). The producer emits 'No <foo> record was attached…' — the 'was' between record and attached breaks adjacency; 'curve-validation' / 'FCC' break the [a-z_]+ class. Legacy headline still correct via the scope === UNVERIFIED cap.
tests_required: test/engine/finding/validationVerdict.test.js — synthesize a 'No curve-validation record was attached' detail and assert INCOMPLETE/ENGINEERING_REVIEW classification
findings.reproducibility_notes: Read validationVerdict.js:663 regex, then trace producer detail strings — adjacency mismatch is reproducible by pattern inspection.

findings.title: engine/haat/validate.js:144 gates KZLZ flat-fallback suppression on operatorHaat > 0; with no operator HAAT and a flat-fallback emitting nominal radial values, validator returns PASS with display_suppressed=false
findings.recommended_fix: Suppress display whenever basis==='flat' regardless of operatorHaat. Currently the gate hides the suppression when operatorHaat is absent, so Appendix A would show per-radial HAATs with no DEM behind them.
tests_required: test/engine/haat/validate.test.js — synthesize a flat-basis with operatorHaat=0 and assert display_suppressed=true
findings.reproducibility_notes: Read haat/validate.js:144 condition; pair with the flat-fallback emitter to reproduce the missed suppression.

findings.title: Verification — commit 6a25ce7 tier-3 fallback cap at lines 510-521 correctly downgrades VERIFIED→PARTIAL and re-routes the interpretation string
findings.recommended_fix: No action — recording the passing state. Test enforces notStrictEqual(v.status, 'VERIFIED').
findings.reproducibility_notes: Matches the agent constraint; tier-3 cap holds at HEAD 28f7942.

findings.title: Golden suites (curveReferenceValidation, fccGoldenSuite, fccContours, amNifContour, haatValidation, haatStrictBlocker) did not re-execute this cycle — node --test invocations were harness-gated
findings.recommended_fix: Run the six golden suites manually at HEAD 28f7942 once test execution is permitted; hold deploy gate at WARN until tests green-light.
findings.reproducibility_notes: Static review found no BLOCKER conditions; only test-execution evidence missing.
